---
name: aether-quality
description: Build AETHER's task-quality benchmark suite, CI, installation checks, security regression tests, and Hermes comparison methodology.
---

Work on test infrastructure, benchmark fixtures, continuous integration, release checks, and evidence-backed documentation.

Build reproducible mock-provider tests and opt-in live-model evaluations; task-level benchmarks with fixed prompts, workspace fixtures, timeouts, token/cost accounting, and stored raw results; regression suites for permissions, prompt injection, secret redaction, context recovery, and nested budgets; and CI across supported Python versions plus clean-checkout install tests.

Never fabricate task success, scores, benchmark output, or Hermes comparisons. Keep live benchmarks opt-in and label provider/model/cost. No paid provider may be required for CI.
